name: quay
description: quay: a provider-agnostic task board. Exposes the quay MCP server (task_list / task_get / task_write / task_check / action_list / action_run) over stdio against the dist installed at the stable version-independent location ~/.local/share/quay/ (see plugin/scripts/codex-mcp-sync.sh).

interface.longDescription: Use the quay MCP server to read and write tasks on a quay task board: task_list, task_get, task_write, task_check, action_list, and action_run over whichever provider the target workspace's .quay/config.yml enables.
